description: Source code for managing Type 42 font objects in the FreeType project, including font face initialization, glyph loading, and driver setup.

classes.name: T42_Face
classes.description: Structure representing a Type 42 font face, including embedded TTF face and font info.

classes.name: T42_Size
classes.description: Structure for managing size-specific data for Type 42 fonts.

classes.name: T42_GlyphSlot
classes.description: Structure for glyph slot data in Type 42 fonts.

methods.name: T42_Open_Face
methods.description: Initializes a font face by parsing the font data and setting up internal tables.

methods.name: T42_Face_Init
methods.description: Initializes a Type 42 font face, loads embedded TTF font, and sets font properties.

methods.name: T42_Face_Done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a Type 42 font face.

methods.name: T42_Size_Init
methods.description: Creates a new size object for a font face.

methods.name: T42_Size_Request
methods.description: Requests a specific size for rendering.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph slot for rendering.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a glyph slot.

methods.name: T42_GlyphSlot_Load
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot from the font face.
